configurator.intro: Set your hotel profile and activate the components you want. All figures are updated instantly. These are indicative estimates based on typical Dutch market conditions.
configurator.build_p: Activate each component to see the financial impact. Build up from storage to a complete ecosystem.
configurator.c1p: Charge during cheap off-peak hours, discharge during expensive peak hours. 261 kWh LFP per unit with 125 kW PCS.
configurator.c2p: Automated optimisation, dynamic tariff response and real-time monitoring. More valuable with ESS.
configurator.c3p: Generate clean energy and store the surplus in the battery. Maximum value realised with ESS.
configurator.c4p: Generate revenue from guest EV charging, powered by stored solar energy. Requires EMS for load management.
configurator.safety_p: Hotels welcome hundreds of guests every night. Our energy systems are built with multiple independent safety layers, because in hospitality safety is the only acceptable standard.
configurator.ctah: Ready to transform your hotel's energy?
configurator.ctap: This is an indicative estimate. For an exact calculation tailored to your property, we are ready to help.
